literal_meaning: এক পা কবরে (one foot in the grave)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার বয়স অনেক হয়েছে, এক পা কবরে।
এই গুরুতর অসুস্থতায় তার এক পা কবরে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is very old; he has one foot in the grave.
With this serious illness, he has one foot in the grave.
note: This idiom directly parallels the English expression and is widely used in everyday Bengali speech to indicate someone is close to death.
